issues.description: Silent semantic change in _set_base_image replaces empty-string KFP-default fallback with hardcoded python:3.12
issues.detail: Previously, on pod-introspection failure, base_image was set to '' so KFP picked its own default. The new code pins python:3.12, changing runtime behavior for every user whose pod lookup fails. This is sold as a display change but rewrites the postcondition of _set_base_image. Split the semantic change from the UI work and preserve or explicitly migrate the empty-string contract.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE duplicated across Python module, TS constant, and TS fallback literal
issues.detail: The whole point of the get_default_base_image RPC is single-sourcing, but 'python:3.12' is now defined in pipeline.py, again as a constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and again as a literal fallback in Commands.ts. These will silently drift on the next bump. Remove the TS duplicates and rely on the RPC with at most one clearly-marked emergency fallback.

issues.description: Replacing inline Input with a 5%-wide IMAGE button plus modal regresses the common editing path
issues.detail: The previous UI exposed base image as a directly editable Input. The new UI requires opening a dialog, disables the button until stepName is set, and shrinks the adjacent Input width with no justification. This strengthens a precondition and removes inline visibility of the current value. Preserve inline editability for the common case or document the contract change.

issues.description: Effective-base-image precedence chain reimplemented in multiple sites instead of one resolver
issues.detail: InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText takes baseImage, pipelineBaseImage, and defaultBaseImage and recomputes precedence inline. The same chain appears in the Jinja template and the dialog placeholder. Factor this into a single resolveBaseImage(step, pipeline, default) function with a stated contract so the three call sites cannot drift.

issues.description: get_default_base_image uses a function-local import, hiding module dependency
issues.detail: The RPC handler does `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function body. No circular-import reason is given, and nb.py already imports from kale at module scope. Move the import to the top of the file so the module boundary and dependency are honest and statically analyzable.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR is sold as a display feature but ships a real runtime semantic change in _set_base_image, swapping the empty-string "delegate to KFP" fallback for a hardcoded python:3.12. It also defeats its own single-source-of-truth RPC by duplicating DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE in the TS constant and a TS literal fallback. The UI swap from inline Input to a 5%-wide IMAGE button plus modal is a regression for the common editing case, and the effective-base-image precedence chain is reimplemented across three sites instead of being factored into one resolver. Split the semantic change from the UI work, centralize the constant, restore inline editing, and consolidate the precedence logic.
